description: One approval of one change of roots. Signed by one of the roots in force and then by the personal key of the person who holds it, so every approval is a root and a named person together. It cites the change by its reference, which fixes the change's position and terms, so an approval cannot be moved to another change.

change.description: The identity of one signed evidence record.

custodian.description: A stable identity written as a URI. Syntax is not authentication.

custodianPublicKey.description: A public key: a registered algorithm and the key's bytes in strict padded base64.

details.description: Issuer-defined detail: up to 64 named scalars. Nothing in it is interpreted by the base kinds, and nothing in it is content; content goes behind a reference.
